gloss: to read and compare; to compare by reading

definitions.gloss: to read and compare; to read several texts side by side
definitions.explanation: To read two or more texts (articles, books, drafts, translations) in order to compare them. The objects compared are typically marked with を or と.

examples.japanese: {二|に}つの{新聞|しんぶん}を{読|よ}み{比|くら}べる。
{翻訳|ほんやく}と{原作|げんさく}を{読|よ}み{比|くら}べてみた。
examples.english: I read the translation and the original side by side.

examples.japanese: {各社|かくしゃ}の{記事|きじ}を{読|よ}み{比|くら}べると、{同|おな}じ{事件|じけん}でも{切|き}り{口|くち}が{違|ちが}うことがよく{分|わ}かる。
examples.english: When you read and compare the articles from each company, you can clearly see that the angles differ even on the same incident.

notes:
Compound of {読|よ}む (to read) + {比|くら}べる (to compare).

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. The texts being compared are marked with を; for explicit pairing, use と.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新聞|しんぶん}を{読|よ}み{比|くら}べる: read and compare newspapers
- {翻訳|ほんやく}を{読|よ}み{比|くら}べる: compare translations
- {原文|げんぶん}と{訳文|やくぶん}を{読|よ}み{比|くら}べる: compare the original and the translation

SIMILAR COMPOUNDS WITH 〜{比|くら}べる:
- {見|み}{比|くら}べる: look at and compare (visually)
- {聞|き}き{比|くら}べる: listen to and compare (audio)
- {食|た}べ{比|くら}べる: taste and compare (food)
